valueProps.title: Why ElectroLoop?
valueProps.subtitle: A WEEE management integrator that coordinates certified partners to deliver a complete solution: pickup, documented traceability, and friction-free REP compliance.

cards.title: 100% WEEE-focused
cards.desc: Exclusively dedicated to electronic waste. We coordinate specialized partners at each stage: logistics, certified treatment, material recovery, and REP reporting.

cards.title: Certified data destruction
cards.desc: Secure erasure or physical media destruction. Individual certificate per serial number, valid for compliance audits and normative reporting.

cards.title: Traceability you can audit
cards.desc: Not just a certificate at the end. Real-time digital tracking of every component, with downloadable reports ready for your REP audit or ESG report.

cards.title: REP partner, not just vendor
cards.desc: We manage your full REP obligation: registration, reporting, and audits included. You focus on your business and we close the loop.

strip.title: On the path to authorization — August 2026
strip.desc: We structure operations to comply with REP Law N°20.920, Decree 148 and health authorizations. Currently operating with certified partners.

chain.title: Your pickup arrives. Here's what happens next.
chain.subtitle: We show you every step of the process with certified partners. Digital tracking, downloadable reports, and certification valid for REP and ESG.

steps.title: Pickup at your premises
steps.desc: We coordinate collection with certified logistics partners, transport manifests, and signed receipt. Confirmation within 48 hours.

steps.title: Certified reception & weighing
steps.desc: Every WEEE item is weighed, photographed, and entered into our traceability system with unique serial number. Digital report in 3-5 business days.

steps.title: Certified data destruction
steps.desc: Secure erasure or physical media destruction. Individual certificate per device with serial number, method, and date, valid for compliance audits.

steps.title: Dismantling & sorting
steps.desc: Manual and mechanical separation of components: ferrous metals, copper, aluminum, circuit boards, plastics, and hazardous materials.

steps.title: Material recovery
steps.desc: Recovery of copper, gold, silver, palladium, aluminum, and engineering plastics. Materials re-enter the productive cycle as secondary raw materials.
steps.tag: Materials return to the productive cycle

steps.title: Certificate in your inbox
steps.desc: Digital certificate of final disposal, material recovery report, and environmental impact metrics (CO₂ avoided, kg recovered). Valid for ESG and REP audit.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: We simplify your WEEE REP compliance by coordinating certified partners, delivering reports ready for the Ministry of Environment.

items.title: Collection, Logistics & Data Destruction
items.desc: We coordinate pickup with certified logistics partners and transport manifests. Secure data erasure or media destruction with individual certificate per serial number, valid for compliance audits.

items.title: Treatment & Recovery
items.desc: With specialized partners: dismantling, sorting and processing of electronic waste. Recovery of precious metals and valuable materials that re-enter the productive cycle as secondary raw materials.

items.title: REP Management & Reporting
items.desc: We guide you through your REP obligation as a producer: registration, reporting to the Ministry of Environment, and auditable documentation. Ready for audits and ESG.

process.title: How It Works
process.subtitle: A transparent, certified process from start to finish

steps.title: Collection
steps.desc: We coordinate WEEE pickup at your facility with our own fleet and certified transport manifests.

steps.title: Classification
steps.desc: Reception, weighing and categorization of equipment by type, composition and condition.

steps.title: Pre-treatment
steps.desc: Decontamination, safe extraction of hazardous components (batteries, refrigerants, screens).

steps.title: Recovery
steps.desc: Separation and refining of precious metals and materials with value. Referral to specialized recyclers by material type.

steps.title: Certification
steps.desc: Issuance of final disposal certificates and auditable reports for REP compliance and sustainability programs.

compliance.title: Regulatory Compliance
compliance.subtitle: Structured to operate in accordance with REP regulations and environmental standards
compliance.description: REP Law (Law N° 20.920) establishes extended producer responsibility for waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE). ElectroLoop is an integrator operating with certified partners, structured to comply with all required technical, environmental and safety standards. Operational launch August 2026.
